在 LM Studio 中加载 VLM 后自动启用图片；lms load 的公开: Images are automatically enabled after loading a VLM in LM Studio; lms load public parameters do not provide a unified vision switch. Capabilities are determined by the model and loaded components; text-only input restrictions can be configured via the gateway.
MLX-LM 用于文本，MLX-VLM 用于多模态；LM Studio 可在应用: MLX-LM is for text, MLX-VLM for multimodal; LM Studio can load in-app. New Splash also requires matching draft models. Actual compatibility depends on model architecture and engine version.
检测到 Prism 专属量化或 Bonsai 2 特殊变换。仅使用已支持这些变换: Prism-exclusive quantization or Bonsai 2 special transforms detected. Use only Prism engines that support these transforms; standard llama.cpp may read the file but output incorrect results.
此模型是旧 packed 封装，由匹配的旧版 Splash 加载自己的配套组件，: This model is a legacy packed wrapper, loaded by matching legacy Splash with its own components; DFlash2 cannot be specified separately. Please download the new main model and associate draft and vision components in the new main model.
GGUF 通常选择一个量化版本；视觉模型还需对应 mmproj。MLX / Sp: GGUF usually selects one quantized version; vision models also require the corresponding mmproj. MLX / Splash packages should download all weights, configs, and tokenizers. After download, compatible engines are scanned automatically.
MLX-LM 与 MLX-VLM 安装到本工具的独立 Python 环境；保留系: MLX-LM and MLX-VLM are installed in this tool's independent Python environment; system MLX libraries and old runtime environments are preserved. Text mode uses MLX-LM, multimodal mode uses MLX-VLM.
加载带 vision 能力的注册模型后自动启用图片；没有统一的 serve --: After loading a registered model with vision capabilities, images are enabled automatically; there is no unified serve --vision switch. Model capabilities after startup are verified via /api/show; pure text input limits are set per model at the gateway.
可在主模型的“关联启动组件”中选择本草稿。新版 Splash 和支持 DFlas: You can select this draft in the main model's "Associated Startup Components". New Splash and MLX-VLM with DFlash support can load this component; MLX-LM does not support this format. After size match, the engine still verifies the model family.
Splash packed 是旧版专用封装，需要支持此格式的 Splash 组件: Splash packed is a legacy-specific package requiring a Splash component that supports this format. New Splash loads from upstream MLX / GGUF; these packed files still cannot be handed directly to other engines.
DFlash2 可交给新版 Splash 或支持 DFlash 的 MLX-VL: DFlash2 can be handed to new Splash or MLX-VLM multimodal components with DFlash support. MLX-LM does not support this format; new Splash must use a draft. After size check passes, the engine still verifies if the main model family matches.
